title: Prior authorization and specialty pharmacy access for Prescriptions & Renewals
content:
**Specialty pharmacy services statement.**

**Prior authorization.** Where the class requires the payer's prior authorization, a Prescriptions & Renewals prescription is transmitted, and a renewal approved, only after the payer's prior authorization is recorded as approved. The evidence is the prior-authorization status on the system record of the same prescription, read before transmission or approval. A prescription of such a class is created with a prior-authorization status of pending; other prescriptions show "not required".

**Services attached to the class.** The benefits investigation is completed within the class's benefits investigation period in business days, copay assistance enrollment is offered where the class offers copay assistance, and medication teaching is completed before the first fill where the class requires patient education.

**Dispensing.** A specialty prescription is filled only by a designated specialty pharmacy.

**Denied authorization.** A denied prior authorization leaves the prescription untransmitted, and it is discontinued if the payer's appeal is not pursued.

**Self-pay patients.** A patient whose Patient Financial Account is a Self-Pay Account needs no prior authorization but pays the pharmacy's cash price.

**Outcomes by prior-authorization status (class requiring prior authorization).**

| Recorded status | Transmission or renewal approval |
|---|---|
| approved | may proceed |
| pending | not yet |
| denied | not transmitted; discontinued if the appeal is not pursued |
